name: emucat
description: Self-hosted web catalog and local launcher for 86Box and QEMU virtual machines.

scripts.check: pnpm build:contracts && pnpm -r check && cargo check --manifest-path agent/Cargo.toml --all-targets
scripts.lint: eslint . && prettier --check . && cargo fmt --manifest-path agent/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path agent/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: pnpm build:contracts && pnpm -r test && cargo test --manifest-path agent/Cargo.toml
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build:contracts && cargo build --manifest-path agent/Cargo.toml && pnpm --filter @emucat/api test:e2e
scripts.dev: pnpm build:contracts && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names contracts,api,web --prefix-colors gray,cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @emucat/contracts dev" "pnpm --filter @emucat/api dev" "pnpm --filter @emucat/web dev"
